Method of Attack: Publishing fake ads on popular online marketplaces to lure users to fraudulent merchant sites or phishing pages that steal payment data
Using Telegram bots to provide phishing pages impersonating popular classifieds, marketplaces, and delivery services
Sending fake payment forms obtained from Telegram bots to steal card details
Using local phone numbers and third-party messaging services to communicate with victims
Scam-as-a-service model with phishing kits provided by Telegram bots
Impacted Systems: Popular online marketplaces and classifieds in Europe and post-Soviet countries
Brands abused include LeBonCoin, Allegro, OLX, Sbazar, FAN Courier, Lalafo, Kufar, DHL
Attack Vector: Fake courier service websites and scam merchant websites
Indicators of Compromise: Fake URLs to courier service websites or scam classified/marketplace sites with payment forms
Telegram bots providing phishing kits and fake payment forms
Local phone numbers used by scammers
Ads published on popular marketplaces and classifieds
